method: Linux Chromium production preview, healthy desktop CPU/storage; 20 ms main-thread heartbeat during real file import and durable commit; exact stored command comparison and reload

boundedLegacy.method: Node import of a valid format-1 file at the command-count limit; no browser rendering claim

sameBuildReplayComparison.method: Single same-build Node trial, identical parsed commands and initial state; no physical-device or population claim

boundedBrowser.method: Actual production Chromium file import, durable commit, portable download/pure-reader reimport, reload and Timeline first/latest pages; limit leaves no room for another command

limits: Owned replay removes per-command whole-state copies; validation, checksums, serialization and cloning still cost time. Serialization, cloning and rendering still use the main thread. The maximum-size browser case verifies durable format-2 import/export/reload and bounded Timeline rendering; it does not establish physical-device acceptance. Default exports use a revision-zero checkpoint if the latest snapshot exceeds 2 MiB; histories whose complete log plus minimal envelope still exceeds that bound are rejected without truncation. Validation has a 20-second per-request deadline; oversized/incompatible data is rejected without writes.
